entities.name: Ferid Džanić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ferid Džanić was a Bosniak soldier during World War II. A member of the SS Handschar Division, he was one of the leaders of an unsuccessful anti-German mutiny in Villefranche-de-Rouergue, in which he was killed.
